chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
Insulting a believer is wickedness, fighting him is disbelief, consuming his flesh is disobedience to Allah, and the sanctity of his wealth is like the sanctity of his blood.

key_terms.أَكْلُ لَحْمِهِ: consuming his flesh, i.e. backbiting him
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer, whose dignity and rights are protected
key_terms.حُرْمَةُ مَالِهِ: the inviolability and sanctity of his wealth
key_terms.كُفْرٌ: disbelief, indicating extreme gravity in this context

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about insulting, backbiting, fighting, and violating the property of a believer?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the grave sanctity of the believer’s honor, life, and property. It condemns verbal abuse, violent aggression, and backbiting, while affirming that a believer’s wealth is inviolable just as his blood is inviolable.
